10101010.t: Tofu Street
Bankruptcy, bankruptcy!!
We're in the red!!!
BANKRUPTCY!!!
It's really over this timeeee!
Why the sudden panic now? This happens all the time.

Now that's a great shout.
Yeah. True rock spirit.
That's why I told you last week...
What?!
Eek! ...
A.ny.way!

At this rate, we're definitely going under!
We're all going to end up on the streets!
Isn't that how it always is?

No, it's not!
Are you trying to make me repeat myself?!
I'm saying we need to come up with a plan, a plan!
A plan...
Should we start collecting cardboard boxes ahead of time?
Oh, if you need those, I saw some at the Panoticon recycling center.
Personally, I find appliance cardboard boxes the most comfortable because they're nice and thick.

No, no, no! I'm saying we can solve this if we just have a plan!
Why are you all assuming we're getting evicted!
Suji, what's the opposite of being in the red?
Um... being in the black?
Exactly! You're definitely the brain of our team!
(Should I really be praised for something like this...?)
In other words! The deficit... just needs to be covered by making a profit!
Oh... (claps)
Oh... (claps)
Um... excuse me...
Yes? What is it? Speak up.
How... are we going to make a profit...?
Huh...? W-Well... we can just make money, right?
Then... why are we in the red in the first place...?
U-Um... because we spent too much?
Uh-oh, she's mad.

A raging storm, thunder clashing with lightning.
That's a nice vibrato.
Ah, ahaha...

Hold on! Suji, stop looking at me like that!
I get it already!
Mmm... was the new tofu press we bought last week the problem?
...Then the cauldron we bought the week before that?
...The mixer we bought a month ago?
Then what on earth is it?!
All of those are part of it, but...
...Do you remember... the Panoticon... last week?
We tried to pioneer a new market and failed.
If it had worked out, we would've successfully dominated the Panoticon market.
These are the losses we took because former inmates have been avoiding our shop ever since...
Oh...
Eeeeek?!
Let me see, let me see.
Just how much...
H-Heeeeeeeeeek?!?! Kasa & Rona

10101011.t: I was a bit surprised to hear that the Panoticon was attacked, but...
This actually gives us a chance to spend some cash and redraw the board.
Once the storm passes, the chaff is bound to be swept away.
Let's use this opportunity to clean them all out.
For the true peace of Tofu Street...
Oh, Boss. What are you doing in the dark?
Turn on the lights before you ruin your eyes. Whatever it is you're doing.
Hey! I was right in the middle of a good moment!
Oh, is that so? Sorry to interrupt!
Let me know when you're done doing your "thing"!
No, I didn't mean it like that!
Once we succeed, the first thing I'm doing is replacing those idiots.

10101020.t:
Sometime after the Panoticon incident.
On a day like any other, as I was still struggling with poverty...
Suddenly, I got hungry.
Tofu Street
E-Excuse me...
I was, indeed, hungry.
That thing you're holding... it's not a free sample...
I know.
Put it on my tab.
W-We don't do tabs here...
You can start now. Come on, between us.

Between... us?
W-What kind of relationship... do we have...?
...A relationship bound by crime and debt...?
...That doesn't sound helpful at all...

M-More importantly, please stop eating without paying.
This is tofu we need to sell.
If we don't boost our sales somehow, the Tofu Troupe will go bankrupt...
You guys? Bankrupt?
Actually...
I heard about the Tofu Troupe's current situation from Suji.

So... we're in a tough spot if we don't increase our sales...
We can barely even pay the interest right now...
I see...
Hang in there! You can do it! I believe in you guys!
Ugh...!? Wh-What strong grip...
...You still need to pay. For the tofu.
It was a sample, a sample! Customer service! Promotion!
Th-This time, I'm not letting you get away with it!

Victoria told me that if anyone tries to eat without paying this time,
I have to get the money from them by any means necessary!
Hey, I don't have any money! Check my pockets! I'm completely broke!
I-In that case...
Y-You'll have to pay with your body!!
What...?!
No wonder you were looking at me so lecherously from the start! You're planning to squeeze and massage my body like tofu, aren't you?!
N-No, I'm not! I would never think about...
Well, maybe a little bit...
A-Anyway! No free rides!
*Sigh*... I guess I have no choice...
Fine, do whatever you want with me!
*Pant*... *pant*...
*Huff*, *puff*... *sigh*...
Ugh...!
Hyaa...!
Th-There! Right there!
Here? You want me to... put it in here?

Yes! Th-There!
Deep inside... Please put it in...
Alright, that's my specialty!
Th-Thank you for your hard work...
Wow, I seriously thought I was going to die... Doing all this manual labor just to get some tofu that's about to expire...
Hey, is that really it? No more moving tofu, right?!
Yes... that's all the tofu organizing for the fridge today.
By the way... you're saying all those mountains of tofu earlier were unsold leftovers?

Business must be really bad.
How have you not had a single customer this whole time?

I know...
It's gotten especially worse ever since that new franchise tofu shop opened up at the end of the street.
The taste isn't bad, and their prices are incredibly cheap...
Hmm...
A-Anyway, we should probably start...
Whoa?!

S-Sorry.
I'll step back, so please give me a second...
No, this is perfect right now.
No, I asked you to step back...
Hey, hey... Don't you know this is the Protein Tofu Alliance's turf? We paid a fair price to rent this spot.
10101020.n: Protein Tofu Alliance AProtein Tofu Alliance

10101020.t:
What are you Mapo Tofu Clan bastards doing hanging around here...?
Your turf is two blocks down.
10101020.n: Protein Tofu Alliance BProtein Tofu Alliance

10101020.t: Kuhuhu... It seems you're misunderstanding something.
As of yesterday, this block has been taken over... I mean, contracted by the Mapo Tofu Clan.

So you guys should pack up and get lost.
You're going to get protein all over our tofu.
What did you say?! You bastards... Are you looking down on protein right now??
10101020.n: Protein Tofu Alliance AProtein Tofu Alliance

10101020.t:
Exactly! All you do is stuff cheap capsaicin into your tofu!
Where did your sense of nutrition and health go?!
10101020.n: Protein Tofu Alliance BProtein Tofu Alliance

10101020.t: Huh? We don't use that cheap capsaicin! You guys are the ones using cheap synthetic protein!!
Yeah, exactly! How dare you bring that fake tofu around here!!
Take that back right now!
10101020.n: Protein Tofu Alliance AProtein Tofu Alliance

10101020.t: You take it back!
I knew it... Do muscleheads really not learn until they get a good beating?
Kuhuhu... In that case, we have no choice but to teach you with our bodies.
Huh?! Who's teaching who?!
10101020.n: Protein Tofu Alliance AProtein Tofu Alliance

10101020.t: The sin of insulting our tofu... We'll carve it into every single one of your muscles!
10101020.n: Protein Tofu Alliance BProtein Tofu Alliance

10101020.t: Watch out! A turf war has broken out between the shops!
...Isn't this your turf? Why are they the ones fighting over it?
Ah... To cover the losses from the last Panoticon incident... we borrowed money using our rights to some areas as collateral...
But now that we're out of the picture, it seems a dispute arose over the contract for that area.
A-Anyway... they'll figure it out amongst themselves, so let's back away...

Right, just a sec... Let me grab a tofu from the fridge.
That much should be fine as a fee for my labor, right?
Y-Yes... Wait, what?! Hold on!
Huh...?

...*Cough*, *cough*...
Ugh, I can't believe a stray bullet just flew out of nowhere and slammed into the fridge...
H-Hey. Are you okay?
...The tofu... The tofu...
Uh-oh, she's got that crazed look in her eyes... Is this a sign of danger?
DIE!!!
...They say the quiet ones are the scariest when they're angry.
Aaaaah! Die! Everyone die!
...By the way, why is she just firing a barrage of healing bullets while telling everyone to die?
Hey! We've been waiting forever, why aren't you back... Wait, what?
Kyaaa! Our tofu that we spent all night making!!!!
Our tofu, made with pesticide-free organic beans entirely by hand!!
Mmh. Nice shout. Good marketing.
Except we have nothing left to sell!!!
You're all dead meat today☆!

Heh... I've been so stressed out since the Panoticon incident anyway...
Why don't we have some real fun today?!
Today, we play death metal!!!
You crazy bastards!!!

10101030.t: Hope is a good thing.
Perhaps, even the best of things.
But...
Panoticon Room
Shoot, I didn't even get to give those punks a proper taste of our bullets yet!
I can't believe the Donut House intervened there... Why are they only fast at times like this?!

Well, someone must have called it in fast.
Not that I mind a Panoticon encore, though...
Ugh... I'm sorry... I'm so sorry...
With these idiots, I felt like I could easily abandon all hope.
It hasn't been that long since I escaped the Panoticon, and I'm already spending another day here...

That brat Marcia, rushing in all excited just to boost her performance rating...
Ugh, she's so annoying.

Normally they don't show up with their sirens blaring until everything is already over.
They were pretty quick today, huh?
It ended before we could even reach the climax this time...
The other side got let off with a warning... Why only us? They're the ones who started the fight...
Of course, we did completely annihilate☆ those guys who picked a fight with us! Ahaha☆
You guys were the ones who did the "annihilating☆." I didn't do anything, so why was I dragged in too?
Oh, come on, we're practically one and the same mind and body by now! You can at least share that much with us!
I don't know about the one mind part, but sharing one body does sound a bit tempting...
But it really was strange. Normally, no one is stupid enough to pick a fight with us.
Did you guys make some enemies or something?
A grudge? Oh, please. There's no way anyone would hold a grudge against a beautiful young president who runs her business as ethically and honestly as me...
...Right?
Well, if it's Victoria, she probably has a whole truckload of people holding grudges against her.
Ah, ahaha☆ It was purely business, B-U-S-I-N-E-S-S!
What bothers me more is that there were guys willing to pick a fight with us, even if it was a turf we already gave up.
They weren't the type who didn't know what happens when they mess with the Tofu Troupe.
Maybe they're just idiots who can't learn unless they get beaten up on a regular basis.
Scary, scary. Seriously, where did you guys even learn to be like this?

Business is a wild jungle.
In this world, it's eat or be eaten.
That's why we need marketing...
With your marketing, instead of eating the market, I think we'd end up throwing it all right back up.
You want a piece of me, you bastard?!

Ugh, but this is a serious problem...
Sales were already bad, and now even the tofu stock we had left is completely ruined.
At this rate, the Tofu Troupe is going bankrupt for real! It's like, "Goodbye everyone!☆"

Well, I'm sure you guys will be fine.
Can't you just resolve it quickly like you always do?
Oh? What's this? Sounds like a compliment, but... feels a bit off?

Haha, what are you talking about?
I have no idea what you mean!
Well, I should probably get going...
Wh-Where... do you think... you're going...?
Huh? Home, obviously... More importantly, that hurts, so could you let go of me?
No... I can't let you go like this...
I mean, I'm glad to hear that, but...
...The tofu money.
Huh?
You still haven't paid for the tofu.
What do you mean? I thought I paid for that by helping you organize earlier...
No, not that...
You need to pay... for the ruined tofu.
...What?
Hey, that wasn't my fault! It was an accident! An unfortunate accident! I'm just a victim caught in the crossfire!
But , if you hadn't opened the fridge door...

Exactly! Our fridge is made of alloy to withstand turf wars!
Which means the one who provided the cause might also be held responsible!
That makes absolutely no sense!!
The tofu was all smashed... If only the door had been kept closed...

If only we had finished organizing a bit faster...
If only someone hadn't eaten without paying...
...I can't forgive you.
Unforgivable, unforgivable...
Unforgivableunforgivableunforgivableunforgivableunforgivable...!
Hey?! I wasn't even the one who destroyed them?! Aaaargh!!
Are you guys just going to stand there and watch?! Help me!!
Hmmm, what should we do?
Hey, hey... If you want to make a deal, make us an offer.

Nothing in this world is free.
Pay to leave... or rather, pay to live.
Come to think of it, someone was trying to sneak away earlier, weren't they? Mmm?
Oh , ... just a second ago you were trying to play dumb, and now you're begging for help!
Tell us... ... what exactly are we to you?
See? You can't even answer.

Then we have nothing to say to you either.
Good luck! Make sure you pay Suji back for the tofu.

Oh, right, you were totally broke too, weren't you?
Well, then you'll just have to pay with your body again! Ahaha☆
Ugh...! You delinquent gyaru...!
...Wait! Time out! Let's talk this out, okay?!
Oh? You think you can settle this with just a few words?

...Aren't we business partners and friends?!
We even raided the Panoticon together!
And that's exactly why we're in the red.
Fine, I get it! I'll pay you back later somehow! I'll even subscribe to your tofu!!
Hmmm...
Well, alright! What are friends for, after all!
Suji, let him go now.
It's okay, Suji. We can always make more tofu and earn more money.
But... the tofu...
The tofu we all made together...

Rona worked so hard to grow the organic beans to make it...
and Kasa stayed up all night performing and singing on the streets for marketing...
And Victoria, you worked so hard making the tofu yourself and finding buyers for it...!
...Silly.
Huh?!
You silly, silly girl. Were you really worrying about all that?
Ahaha☆ Suji is such a silly girl!
Whew, we've been working together for quite a while, but she still has her cute moments.
That's Suji's charm. Haha!
H-Hng... Wh-Why are you all petting me...?
What's this? I feel like I should join in too...
Uh-uh.
Sorry, but squishy Suji time is strictly for the Tofu Troupe!
Hmph. And here I thought we were friends. So stingy.
I want squishy Suji time too.
Fu-fu. If you want to be true friends, we need to get a little closer first!
What? How are we supposed to get any closer than this!
Isn't that obvious?
You have to prove that you're useful to the Tofu Troupe!

10101040.t: Panoticon Room
...Fine, then I'll help you.
My IQ of 150, and your IQ of 150.
And adding those guys' 30, we'll come up with a perfect plan using our combined IQ of 330.

Um... why is the combined total for the three of them only 30...?
They aren't that bad...!
Be grateful I didn't put them in the negatives.

By the way, the tofu here in the Panoticon lacks firmness.
Are they using cheap stuff?
Maybe we could deliver the tofu first and collect the payment later.
Oh... But what if they don't pay?
Haaah?! They take our tofu and don't pay?! From that point on, it's a deal written in blood!
...Please at least bump them up to 40.
That's only an increase of 3.333 per person...
...Anyway. Since we're all in the same boat, let's find a way to resolve this mess.
By the way, exactly how much is the debt?
...Here...
Hiiieeeek?!
Oh, u-um...

Please lie still.
You fainted backward and hit your head...
Then this strange sensation on the back of my head... Urgh...

That's just my lap, actually...
Your scalp was slightly grazed, but I used a healing bullet, so you should be fine...
Ahem, ahem... Good, excellent elasticity. Keep up the good work.
Oh... Yes... Thank you...?
More importantly, could you please get up now...? My legs are falling asleep...
No, this is perfect right now.
Ah! That was a great rest! I was just about to get up anyway!
...Whew. Now I can finally stretch my legs...
...But something suddenly occurred to me.
...How very sudden.
In a fight over the same turf... the way the police showed up unusually fast, and how the troublemakers managed to slip away...
It's just a hunch, but I'm pretty sure someone's pulling the strings behind the scenes.
Pulling... the strings?! Who?
...If I knew that, would I be saying this? I just smell a rat, that's all.
I-I see...
But is there really nothing? Like, have you guys made any enemies?
Oh, we've made plenty of enemies! Enough to hold a clearance sale.
What, you guys were still here?
That hurts! You were only knocked out for an hour or two anyway.
While waiting for Suji to nurse you back to health, we cleaned up the wrecked shop a bit.
Okay, fine, but... just how many enemies did you make to say something like that?
Well, the Tofu Troupe might not dispense favors, but we sure dispense grudges.
Grudges for sale! Never repaid!
Right, I get that you guys live pretty recklessly.
But if we can't pinpoint a specific grudge... could the alternative be a turf war?
Turf war?
Your spot is right in front of the Panoticon, right? Anyone would die for a location like that.
Besides, since it's a spot you have to secure by force, if they couldn't beat you with raw strength, they'd try to kick you out by any means necessary.
That's...
Well, I guess they're doing this because they can't easily mess with you directly.
As far as I know, you guys are the strongest merchants on Tofu Street.
Aha☆ Not to brag, but totally!
We're not easy targets.
So the question is, "who" is pulling the strings...?
Ohhh, is the great detective finally making his entrance?
Honestly, I have no idea!
...  Everyone

Hey! You got our hopes up for nothing!
Give me back my anticipation!
Ah, whatever! Who do you think I am? If I knew that, I'd be a detective, not a fixer!!

And besides, you need evidence to deduce anything.
What do you expect me to do when we have absolutely nothing to go on?!
Evidence... Evidence...
Are there any other fights you've had recently? Like with some faces you've never seen before?

Hmm, I don't know. We've fought so many people lately.
Fights break out almost daily on Tofu Street.
U-Um...
Nothing really stands out. Our marketing was perfect, too.
Except for the part where we got reported for noise pollution!
Look who's talking! You got reported for operating illegally.
Do you have any idea how much we had to pay in damages for smashing all those doors?
With all those damages combined, we could have bought the Panoticon!
What?! You wanna go right now?!
Bring it on!!
Leaving those two idiots aside... What about a business deal gone wrong? Like, a broken contract or something?
U-Um...
Well, the price of tofu did drop recently, so we took a loss.
But we're merchants through and through. We always honor our contracts.
I... just thought of something...
Tsk... Then what on earth is it... Who is trying to shake things up...?
E-Excuse me!!
That person... might know...
That... person?
Yes... You've probably heard of them...
The Demon of the Panoticon...
The Panoticon's...
Devil...?
Who is that? Everyone
You guys don't know either?
Uh... Seriously... you don't know? They're pretty famous on Tofu Street...
Living in the shadows of Tofu Street... Like a legend of the underworld...
Nope, never heard of them!
First time hearing it.
Who's that?
With everyone reacting like this... the credibility of this rumor suddenly drops to zero.
No... I-It's true...! They're really famous...!
Sure, they're famous. Now five of us know about them.
Eh? We weren't listening. Rona & Kasa
...Correction. Let's make it three.
N-No, that's not it...! They really exist...! Really...!
Really? Then... how did you find out about this famous underworld devil anyway?
Huh?
You said they're a legend of the underworld. How did you get to know someone so famous?
W-Well...
I found out about them when I first met these guys...
Victoria, do you remember? Back when we were still attending Mise en Place...
Whoa, hold on!
Y-Yes?
Is this a flashback scene by any chance?
A flashback scene? U-Um, well, it is a memory...
Keep it short and sweet. If it's too long, I'm going to sleep.
O-Okay... I'll try to keep it as short as possible...

10101050.t: Inside Mise en Place
Ah, you cannot graduate.
...What?
Wait, wait, wait... what do you mean by that?
Surely my final exam grades were at the very top?
Yes, that is correct...

Same here. Even if my grades weren't...
my sales and business performance results were definitely number one.
Yes, that is also correct.
Number one in popularity. Peace! Top star!
W-Well, that is also true, but...

Then what's the problem?! Not graduating...
Fame, honor, and wealth are waiting for us in our future!

I can't stay here for another second!
In fact, I cannot accept the fact that I can't graduate!!
Ah... well... all three of you are fully qualified.
But your scores... you have so many demerits that you don't have enough graduation points.
...Demerits?
Yes.
What? My sales pitch was perfect. And my ingredient selection was perfect too.
There shouldn't be any demerits in my business—
Exactly. My music is solely determined by the spirit of the audience.
Well... there's no problem with that part...
Victoria?
Yep!
Causing a fire while cooking: 3 times.
Damaging kitchen utensils: 5 times.
What? Anyone does that—
Assaulting customers and forced sales: 67 times.

In addition, terrorism against ingredient monopolies
and vigilante justice against cartels: 19 times... Is that correct?
Ahhhhh...
Well, you see. Let's just say there were circumstances...
Let's say developing new tofu dishes requires some sacrifices, sort of...
Ah, ahaha☆
And... Rona?
Yes!
Rona...
You have never submitted any dishes.
I am merely a sales representative, after all.
Securing fresh ingredients and supplying them to the right places—
Excuse me... but we are a culinary school...
...W-Was that so...?
And... Kasa?
Yeah.
Kasa...
The food was good, the service was good, everything was great...
Fufu.

Victoria, Rona. Goodbye... I enjoyed being with you guys.
I'll go ahead and wait for you in the wider world.
My heart will always be with you—

But we received reports for noise pollution and illegal performances.
Over a hundred times, in fact...

And they say you focus more on the performance than the food...
You even sang to an empty plate for three hours straight.
...Because my song is the side dish?
Overall results...
All three of you failed to meet the required score.
Therefore—
You cannot graduate.
Ugh, does this make any sense?!
The criteria themselves are clear... but I can't accept this.
Well, at least we got another chance, if that's any consolation.
Well... the school does provide opportunities to make up for the missing scores.

If you cook and achieve a certain amount of sales,
we will grant you performance points for that alone.
However, the deadline is tomorrow... so it will probably be difficult, right?

There's no way you guys can do it.
You daily freeloading, troublemaking parasites! Ohohohoho!
...Is what she must have said!
In front of Mise en Place
Hey, you made up that last part.
But it might not be far from what she was actually thinking.
That's why...
Let's show them what we've got!
Alright!
...But with what?
Uh... I actually haven't thought about that.
Sigh.
Well, as long as we reach the target sales, right? Then...
We can just cook a ton and sell a ton, right?
Well, that's true. So what are we going to sell?

Tofu, of course!
Did you think I'd sell anything other than tofu?

I figured as much.
After all, you are the best Tofu Meister in Mise en Place.
But... where are we going to sell it?
Hmmm...

Location is key in business.
Somewhere with a lot of people if possible...
But rent is expensive overall in Humanitas.
...With our budget, we won't be able to get a decent place.
Heh...
Why?
To catch a tiger, you have to enter the tiger's den.
To catch a whale, you have to go out to sea, right?
Why tigers all of a sudden...?

That obviously means... if you want to sell tofu,
you have to go where tofu is wanted.

Both of you already know, don't you?
Where they buy the most tofu in Humanitas.
No way...
Hmm...
Yes! Right in front of the Panoticon... We're going to Tofu Street!

...I can't really agree to that.
The competition there is insane, you know?

That place is a lawless zone—
I heard it's teeming with wild tofu freaks.
I know that. But... is there any other way?
...Me neither.
Alright, it's decided then! Surely neither of you wants to repeat a year at Mise en Place?
Whew. No choice then.
Since we're already on board... till the very end Rock 'n' roll.
Alright! Then... Let's go!

10101060.t: Tofu Street
Tofu... please buy some... Tofu... please buy some...
Hmm? What's with this tofu? It looks so poorly made...
Ah, ah... please don't touch the tofu like that!

What? We're customers.
Shouldn't we be able to see if the product is good before we buy it?
B-But... ...Whew, why did I end up like this...
(I've always been like this... indecisive, never knowing what to do...)
(I don't even care about tofu in the first place... I was forced to take on the seniors' healthy tofu project too...)
(Why did I take this on...)
Oh, this spot is perfect. It's right in front of the Panoticon, right?
Ah, u-um...
This is my spot...
Oh? Really?
Yes. S-Sorry...
No, don't worry! We're the ones who came late.
But... I really like this spot... Hmm...
Hey, are you selling tofu too by any chance?
What?! Y-Yes... I am...
Then how about we form a <bouten>united front</bouten> here?
A united front...?

Yeah! We're going to sell a ton of tofu here.
Since we're doing it anyway, it would be great to sell your tofu together too, right?
Ah... I-I hadn't really thought about that...
Well, the sales specialist is here—look forward to it.

Should I promote it for free?
Directly from bean to tofu! Fufu.
But... we don't even know each other...
What? You're worrying about that?
Then we're friends starting from now!
...Huh?

Ahahat☆ If we become friends starting now, it's all good!
Then we're not strangers anymore, right?
Th-That...
(...What's with these people...?)
Huh? Hmm? Hmmm?
(Somehow... I don't hate it...)
O-Okay... let's sell them together then.
Awesome! Then, 'The Great Tofu Troupe'! Let's start the business with our new friend!
(Amazing... they've almost sold all the tofu already.)

Ah! You, you just got released, right?!
Take this tofu!!!
(...Though they're mostly forcing it on newly released ex-convicts...)

Huh?! You don't have money for tofu? No worries!
Just give us your address and phone number, and we'll come collect it later!
Hello! We are 'The Great Tofu Troupe'!!

Our theme song for today is
'The Ensemble of Tofu, You, and Me', a song about tofu's love!!

Please show our new song lots of love!!
Oh, and buy lots of tofu too!!
(...Amazing)
(Can I... be like them too...?)
Yahoo☆ Did we sell almost everything?
Ah! Yes... thanks to you guys.
Heheh, what are you talking about? You worked hard selling them too.
Especially the way you handled the tofu...

It's like you're cradling a baby...
Or like a mother bird sheltering something precious...
Your passion for tofu really reached my heart!
Yes... (Actually, I was just worried I'd have to pay for the tofu if it went bad...)
Anyway, you saved our skins! With this, our graduation is...  Huh?

!? H-Hieeeek!?

Tofu?

What made you shed those tears?

it means you have a drive to achieve something.

<bouten>Friends</bouten>.

Fufufu...

with you guys...
